q: Passive form of 'He is going to buy a car' is-
o: A car will be gone to be bought by him
A car is gone to be bought by him
A car will be gone to buy by him
A car is going to be bought by him
e: is going to + V1 গঠনের passive-এ is going to be + V3 বসে, তাই A car is going to be bought by him। অর্থ: সে একটি গাড়ি কিনতে যাচ্ছে। gone অপশনে ভুলভাবে এসেছে, কারণ going to গঠনটি অপরিবর্তিত থাকে। তৃতীয় অপশনেও buy ভুল রূপে আছে।

q: Identify the active form of 'The match was won by our team.'
o: Our team won the match.
Our team has won the match.
Our team was winning the match.
The match won our team.
e:
To change a passive sentence into the active, the agent 'our team' becomes the subject and the subject 'the match' becomes the object. The verb 'was won' is in the simple past, so the active verb is 'won'. Thus we get 'Our team won the match.'
মনে রাখুন:
Passive-এর 'by' এর পরের অংশ Active-এ কর্তা হয়
Tense কখনো বদলায় না

q: Who sent you the message? Choose the correct active voice:
o: By whom the message was sent to you?
By whom was the message sent to you?
By whom were you sent to the message?
Who was the message sent to?
e: প্রশ্নে 'active voice' লেখা থাকলেও প্রদত্ত বাক্যটি নিজেই active, আর অপশনগুলো passive, তাই আসলে passive রূপ চাওয়া হয়েছে। Who দিয়ে শুরু প্রশ্ন passive করলে who বদলে by whom হয় এবং প্রশ্নের কাঠামো রাখতে auxiliary verb subject-এর আগে বসে: By whom was the message sent to you? এখানে message একবচন এবং বাক্য past tense, তাই was + past participle (sent)। ক-তে was subject-এর পরে বসায় প্রশ্নের কাঠামো হারিয়েছে, গ-তে 'sent to the message' অর্থহীন, আর ঘ-তে by whom নেই এবং অর্থও বদলে গেছে। Indirect object you-কে subject করে আরেকটি শুদ্ধ passive হয়: By whom were you sent the message?
